title: Imagery / Photography
slide_intent: Ground a brand story in real people because authentic experience can give a broad promise personal meaning.
strategic_value: People-led photographs with a sense of place can connect Duolingo to learners’ lives beyond the app.
demonstration: A photographic example is beside guidance to show authentic people, their stories and personalities, with references to ordinary activities and environments.
practical_value: Select photographs for the person and story they reveal, rather than treating them as interchangeable decoration.

content_islands.name: Environmental portrait
content_islands.spec: Place the photograph of a woman in a green hat beside a colorful wall in the left panel.

content_islands.name: Photography guidance
content_islands.spec: Place the heading and people, story and everyday-setting guidance in the right column.

reference_purposes.Intent: The source says photographs reflect the company’s character and the people it wants to accompany.
reference_purposes.Application: The copy directs photography toward learners, personalities and real-life situations.
reference_purposes.Expression: The photograph demonstrates the source’s people-led approach.

ingredient.name: Brand photography
ingredient.role: Connect the identity with real people and places.
ingredient.application: Choose images led by people who use Duolingo and reveal their stories or personalities.
ingredient.scope: Historical archived guidelines. Historical photography guidance. The source’s final environment sentence is grammatically incomplete; no extra rule is inferred from that defect.
